summary: Tiered execution splits a gated task into context, decision, execute and verify children. The worker dispatches each by its AgentID profile; the store persists the DAG and its relations atomically.

excerpts.note: Process() dispatches; the tiered gate runs before the circuit breaker check
PersistTieredDAG blocks the parent and inserts children plus relations in one transaction
validTaskTransitions: BLOCKED reaches READY, not COMPLETED

constraints: BLOCKED -> COMPLETED is not a legal transition; resolve the origin through UpdateTaskResult
UpdateTaskResult only accepts a RUNNING task
unknowns: whether tier-escalate is seeded in every deployment
